segments.text: disposal of 46,033 when the target disposal is only 48,313. For municipal trial courts in cities,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Your Honor, an accomplishment rate in 2024 of 153 percent. In 2025, 162 percent and 2026 from

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: January to June, 79 percent. Municipal trial courts, Your Honor, we have an accomplishment rate of

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: 137 percent. In 2025, 157 percent and half of the year, this year, 69 percent. For first-level

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: courts, again, municipal circuit trial courts or the MCTCs, we have an accomplishment rate of 120

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: percent for 2024, 133 percent for 2025 and half of this year, 65 percent. For Sharia circuit courts,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: 117 percent for 2024, 187 percent for 2025.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And half of this year, from January to June, 67 percent. For the Court of Appeals, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: our appellate courts, accomplishment rate in 2024, 108 percent. 2025, 124 percent. And half of the

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: year, 2026 from January to June, 130 percent. For the Sandigan Bayan, Your Honor, it has a bigger

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: accomplishment rate. 2024, 290 percent. 2025, 220 percent. And 2026, January to June, 178 percent.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Court of Tax Appeals, likewise, 2024, 196 percent. 2025, 167 percent. And 2026, from January to June,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: 197 percent. For our judicial reforms, Your Honor, projects and initiatives, we can only cap them

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: with the SPJI milestones, considering that this is the blueprint with which the judicial

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: transformation has carried itself from 2022 to 2027. So milestones on SPJI activity,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: if I only enumerate them, Your Honor. We have the artificial intelligence system for voice to

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: text transcription, which we call the scriptics. And then we have formulated our ICT governance

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: framework, and we are now starting considering or verifying what human-centered augmented

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: artificial intelligence can be used for the Supreme Court that can be for our judicial

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: digital infrastructure. And we have also formulated a framework for the ICT governance framework,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: which will be developed by the Supreme Court. The framework for digital governance and

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: infrastructure can be characterized by the five-year ICT strategic plan released by the

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: MIS, together with the operations manual. And for our digital infrastructure, we have

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: begun with our software-defined wide area network, what we call the SD1. And then the

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: cloud infrastructure and then the Wi-Fi and one GPS backup connectivity for our bandwidth.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And we have likewise developed the procurement of judiciary data center servers,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: and backup storage infrastructure refresh for the Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: For our online learning centers, Your Honor, this has already been used by the Philippine Judiciary Academy.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Likewise, for the JBC, applications are now registered through online registration and application system,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: which we call the ORAS, or O-R-A-S, and then e-voting application, which is a system of voting for our judges.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And we have the JEPs, or the Judiciary Electronic Payment Solution, in the filing of docket fees before our trial courts.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And likewise, we have the Mandatory Continuing Legal Education Information System.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And for our line offices, you have the Human Resource Management System, or the HRMS,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Enhanced Financial Management Information System, which we have renamed as the Financial Information Resource Development, or FIRM.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: We have the e-court, or the Digital Infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: That's what an e-court will look like, Your Honor, which has already been piloted.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And then we have an e-procurement application.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And for any data that is needed coming from our first and second level courts, we have the CMO Data Hub.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: We likewise have the Halls of Justice Management and Courthouse Management System,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: the Bar Application Registration Information System and Tech Assistance, or the BARISTA.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: We have the Philippine Judicial Platform, or the PJP,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: all of which all our judges and court persons,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: and our personnel, actually have PJ365 accounts in their favor for purposes of collaborative networking.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: We have e-notarization for our notaries public.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: We have the United Legal Aid Service of the ULAS portal for the mandatory unified legal aid service for our private practitioners.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And we have the interim promulgation application.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: For Convergence Program, Your Honor, the Justice Sector Coordinating Council,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: which is the coordinating mechanism that makes the justice system.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We have Representative Renee Ko.

segments.text: You have five minutes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And thank you, Mr. Chair, and thank you to the judiciary for the continuous work that we do to ensure that justice reaches to the farthest areas of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At siyempre sa pinaka ordinaryong mamamayang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yung mga tanong din po natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ay gusto nating mabigyan, mapalamnan ng mas marami pang detalye kung paano po siya nagagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang una pong tanong, may discussion na po sa proposed FY2027 Judiciary Budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: totaling 86.271 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: This is a 22% increase from the 2026 GAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And that first double courts such as MTCs and MCTCs posted case disposal rates

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: as low as 65 to 69% in the first half of 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Siguro ang tanong ko po, how much of the 4.3 billion increase in MOOE

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: is specifically allocated to clear backlogs and enable swift, speedy processing of cases

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na gusto pong mas magawa natin, especially at the lower courts?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Yeah, please proceed.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Thank you so much, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Thank you for the question.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: The Honorable Representative Ko.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Part of a disposal target is always a performance benchmark, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And part of the budget that should cover a proper case disposal,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: especially among our first level courts, is a proper case flow management.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: The CMO data hub would usually have statistics to monitor the cases

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: and the case load and the resolutions and disposal of cases of the lower courts.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: We have a statistics and records division from the Court Management Office to interpret this data.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And this is how we would flow into a development of a case flow management system.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Because it will flow from how the cases are handled, how they are calendared, how they are heard, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: All in an administrative way.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: From the point of view of an administrative aspect.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Does that answer the question, Your Honor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang nakuha ko po, Mr. Chair, meron pong ICT upgrades na popondohan para po mag-improve yung backlog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Specifically on calendaring.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Oo.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And digitally.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And siguro ang tanong ko din po, other than na-appreciate natin yung pag-share ng details on how to better calendarize,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ako, first hand ko rin nakita yung sabay-sabay na 30 cases i-assign sa isang araw.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At ang matatapos lang dyan, apat or something.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And then everyone else would have to be re-calendared on a different day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: That is cause for delay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron po bang additional personnel na iniexplore na binubukas yung courts?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Or may bagong rules po ba na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ipapatupad para po mas maklear yung backlogs and to enable the swift, speedy processing of cases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Right now, may na-share po kayong ICT upgrades.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ano ba pong meron pa po?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Thank you, the Honorable Representative Ko.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Other than ICT upgrades, of course, within the digital framework that our lower courts should already have,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: increase or million increase in the budget for the lower court

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: will go to an upgrade and reclassification of the personnel, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And this is really important because how particularly that the salary grade of our lower court personnel

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: have not been upgraded since time immemorial.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So that even a salary grade 1 employee who happens to be a utility worker

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: will still have...

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: a salary of 15,000 pesos only.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So if with the budget proposal, if this be included,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: if this be approved as a part of the appropriation of the Honorable Congress,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: it will really do a lot of wonders so that we can practically have a sufficient,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: attractive and competitive salary networking for our personnel.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And we've always believed that if there is an internal stakeholder engagement

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: wherein they are happy and satisfied,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: it flows with how they work into the...

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: into the delivery of justice, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So thank you po sa pagsagot ng tanong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang isang nanote din po kasi sa continuous deliberations, even here in Congress,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: kulang po yung mga korte, kulang din yung judges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kaya kung ito po ay limited in number, in particular regions, nakaka-contribute din siya doon sa case backlog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So at least...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: now, may nanote po tayong creation of new courts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero persistent po yung problem ng lack of judges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Or even yung pag-fill ng items ng personnel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And nakita po natin sa presentation yung creation of these courts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But as of June 30, 2026, the Judicial and Bar Council lists only seven vacant positions open for application.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And meron pong net decrease yung SC-PLC budget in capital outlay of 3.7%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, can I ask po, despite the creation of new RTCs and family courts,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: how many plantelia positions for judges and court personnel remain unfilled?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At ano pong ginagawa ng Korte Suprema natin to ensure personal services funding match the actual staffing needs of these new courts?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Yes, sir. Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Your Honor, it depends on whether there is already a NOSCA issued or the Notice of Staffing and Classification Action.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Because if there is no NOSCA yet issued, we call it the unorganized courts.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And despite the fact that we want to fill them in, we cannot do so because of the lack of a NOSCA.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: But for those awaiting...

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: But for now, just to answer...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Lack of?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Lack of NOSCA po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ah, okay.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Kasi po, yun po yung appropriation na binibigay po ng DBM para po ma-fund ang personnel, ang judge at personnel po ng isang korte.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, basically po...

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Pero just to answer your question po, ang judge vacancies po namin, as of now,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: It represents 16.7% of the authorized judicial positions.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Pero dahil unfilled po yung 463, kailangan po talaga na antayan namin ang NOSCA.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: But hopefully, this will be remedied by the Fiscal Autonomy Act because the DBM po ay nabibigyan lang po siya ng 120 days

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: para i-issue po siya.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Otherwise, the Supreme Court will now resort to other appropriate measures just to have it funded with the DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Chair, can that be submitted?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yung list of judges and even yung list of court personnel na sa tingin ng judiciary ay kailangan pong may items pero sa kasamaang palad ay hindi po tayo nabibayaan ng DBM na mabigay po at mapondohan po siya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maaari po ba itong masumite?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Maaari po namin i-submite ang listahan po ng mga korte na unorganized, pati po yung funded at unorganized pa rin.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Pero meron din po kaming listahan ng mga judges at kasama po yung court personnel.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: But this will only reflect the total number of judges and court personnel that we have in the judiciary, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Pero pagdating po sa unorganized courts about to be created, korte pa lang po.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Where it is?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: The branch number and where it should be within its territorial jurisdiction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Just an interjection.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Stop muna the time of Congresswoman Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Have you exercised already the 120 days?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Because DBM would seem that they could not, you know, our country needs new judges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: To those we have approved already for creation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, have you already exercised that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Because you should.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So that we can fill this up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We will not wait for the NOSCA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: After all, you have fiscal independence, autonomy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, what is the answer of the Administrator?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Your Honor, as of now, we have not yet exercised that right which is provided for by the Fiscal Autonomy Act.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Because the implementing rules and regulations are still undergoing review by the Supreme Court and Bank.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: It has already been submitted, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: But anytime soon, it will be issued, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, we urge the Supreme Court itself to finish and promulgate the IRR for the law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So that we can already open them because some courts, seven years na na-create.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Five to seven years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And that there is a felt need in many of these districts, cities and provinces for courts to already be organized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Grabe na rin ang backlog eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, when can the Supreme Court, can one of the justices reply on when you will pass the IRR for that law?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So that you start already with your own NOSCA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And then, anyway, you have fiscal autonomy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So that we can already give the required budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Who will answer?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: From the Honorable Associate Justice of the Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Justice Maidas.

segments.text: Isa hong practice na nagaganap, or actually malpractice na nagaganap sa ibaba,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III

segments.text: Maiwasan na yan at matigil na po yung practice na iyon?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Kasi ang mangyayari, pagka maling address, hindi sasagot yung respondent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Sa totoo po, Your Honor, strikto po ang Supreme Court pagdating po sa service ng processes.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Kunyari po merong complaint at nag-issue na po ang korte ng summons para makapagsumite ang isang defendant ng answer,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: especially if it's a personal action, ang una pong nire-require ng korte ay personal service

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: para po yung mga sheriff natin or process servers ay ma-confirm po kung talagang doon nakatira ang isang defendant.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Kung sakaling hindi man po, that's the only time

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: that they can resort to substituted

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: service.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Tapos hindi lang po minsan mangyayari ito. Ang minimum po ngayon na

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: nire-require ng ating Supreme Court ay

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: tatlong beses.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Para po every time po bumalik si sheriff or si process server,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: masigurado po na yung defendant ay talagang nandoon. Kung talaga pong wala,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: ay mare-reflect po iyon sa kanyang return.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So masyado pong strikto ngayon

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: po ang returns ng processes natin para nga po maiwasan na ang isang defendant

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: ay ma-declare na hindi po in default. Ngayon ang aming proseso ay para po magkaroon ng ex parte

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: presentation. Iniiwasan po talaga iyon kung hindi lahat na-verify na walang personal service

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: o substituted service tatlong beses hindi rin nangyari. That's the only time.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: so i think with all this um with all this um uh the rules that we have on strict uh service and

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: processes. Tingin ko po makikita po kung ang defendant ay talagang hindi nakatira sa isang binigay na address ng isang complainant.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. To our Honorable Justices and the judiciary family, magandang hapon po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Firstly, we'd like to convey our full support for the judiciary. Dahil naniniwala po kami na kapag

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: malakas po ang hudikatura, ultimately po ang makikinabang ay ang mga manggagawa at ordinaryong Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I just have few clarifications. Kasi di po ko abugado at gusto ko pong maintindihan

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: sa lente po ng mga manggagawa yung ilang mga usapin po tungkol sa mga proseso ng ating batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Sa Rule 58 po ng Rules of Civil Procedure, pwede niyo po ba kaming bigyan ng kalinawan doon po sa Section 4B?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ah may nakasulat po

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kasi dito, upon approval of the requisite bond, a writ of preliminary injunction shall be issued.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Pwede niyo po ba kaming paliwanagan sa matter na ito?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Thank you po, Your Honor. Kapag po nag-grant, an injunction is usually a prayer, an ancillary remedy.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So provisional remedy siya to a main action. So kung yung action na yun, after hearing, ay gagrant na ng court.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: To answer for the damages that may...

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: That the other, the adverse party will have, kailangan po talaga mag-post ng bond itong movant.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: And that will answer for, as I've said, the damages in the event that the injunction is already, the writ of injunction is already implemented.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Just for example po, in an example, hypothetical case.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So sabi po doon, let a writ of preliminary...

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: preliminary injunction be issued upon putting a bond of X amount.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Halimbawa po, yung petitioner hindi po nakapaglagak ng bond. Ano pong mangyayari doon sa injunction?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Hindi po siya ma-i-implement, hindi po siya ma-i-issue ng court.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Kasi po, kailangan po talaga yung bond is a prerequisite before the writ of injunction or preliminary injunction will issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you po. So ibig sabihin po, if there is no bond, then there is no injunction.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Yes po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa kalinawan na ibinigay po ng hudikatura on this matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So gusto ko lang po ilinaw yan na no bond, no injunction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Susunod ko po na tanong, ano naman po yung mga pamamaraan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Halimbawa naman po, merong mga judges na tingin po natin ay merong erring decision on matters na talagang pinangihimasukan yung mga bagay na wala namang jurisdiction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Halimbawa po ang korte.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ano po yung mga pamamaraan para i-correct po ito?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Ang tanong po ninyo, Your Honor, kung ang isang korte ay walang jurisdiction?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Halimbawa po, wala siyang jurisdiction on the matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Or halimbawa po, nang himasok siya sa isang pasok na clearly nagba-violate po ng mga nakasaad sa batas natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So ano po ang proseso dito, ma'am?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Ano po, marami.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Ang pagkakaalam po, ang isang judge dapat po, dapat well-versed sa batas.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Ang judge po, dapat alam din if they are exercising jurisdiction over a subject matter, over the person of an accused.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So kasi po talagang territorial tayo kung criminal cases or subject matter sa civil cases.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Kung wala pong jurisdiction at yung judge ay biglang nagsabi sa kanyang decision or order ay may jurisdiction siya.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: May remedyo naman po yun that you can either appeal the case if it's really a decision in court or let's say it's an interlocutory order, pwede naman po siyang gawan din ng kaso under Rule 65 ng certiorari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Rule 65 po. Maraming salamat po sa paglilinaw na iyan, Mr. Chair. Iyon lang naman po yung ilang mga katanungan ng kinatawang ito at hopefully po, sa pamamagitan po ng sagot ng ating mga kasama sa hudikatura, ay magsilbi po ito na guidance sa mga manggagawa at sa mga kasong kinasasangkutan ng mga manggagawa. Iyon lamang po. Maraming salamat po and we support the judiciary. Salamat po, Your Honor.

segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Magandang hapon po sa ating Judiciary Department, sa lahat po natin mga justices from the Supreme Court, Court of Appeals, Tax Appeals, Sandigan Bayan. Good afternoon.

segments.text: Mr. Chair, I would just like to respectfully manifest my...

segments.text: full support for the proposed budget of the judiciary. The judiciary is supposed to be the equalizer for the common man. The institution where every Filipino, regardless of wealth or influence, can seek fair treatment under the law. But justice delayed is justice denied.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Kaya dapat sapat ang pondo para mapunan ang vacancies, mabawasan ang backlog, mapabilis ang proceedings, at maging accessible ang courts nationwide.

segments.text: Our support,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Assalamualaikum, marahmatullahi wabarakatuhu. Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair, to the judiciary family. Magandang tanghali po sa inyong lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ako po ay kasamahan ni

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Representative Chel Diokno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At ito pong mga katanungan ay nais niya pong ipaabot sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Una po, dederecho ko nang tatanungin yung tungkol po sa Unified Legal Assistance Service po ng judiciary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Itinatag ng Supreme Court ang Unified Legal Aid Service o ULAS upang mapalawak ang libreng serbisyong legal para sa mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: indigent at marginalized Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Para po sa unang katanungan, can you discuss briefly po to this committee kung paano ginagawang mas accessible ang legal aid sa ULAS?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Unang una po, bawat abogado na covered ng Unified Legal Aid Services ay mandatory po sa kanilang mag-render ng 36 hours of service.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Kaya ang IBP po, or Integrated Bar

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: of the Philippines, ay na-systematized na po ito.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Kadalasan po, sila ay nag-talagang, meron po silang, it's not a portal, but they have their own access points wherein they represent, as you said po, the marginalized people.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Wala na pong kondisyon ng mga ito.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: They just represent these litigants in court and then they register it as part of their service.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So, fill in the 36 hours.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Kadalasan din po ang mga judges, nag-a-appoint na rin po sila ng membro ng IBP through the ULAS para kung alam po nila ng isang litigante ay walang abogado.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So, malaking tulong po talaga itong ULAS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yes. Tama po kayo dun, no, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Magkano na po ang inilaan at nagastos ng judiciary para sa pagpatupad po ng ULAS?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Unang-una po sa opisina nila, 139 million po ang nakalaan kasi importante pong meron pong opisina to monitor the compliance of the lawyers covered sa ULAS.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So ang tawag po natin doon ay ULASO, hindi ba? ULAS Services. So ?139,098,000 po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat po. Para sa pangatlong katanungan, ilan na po ang aktuwal na natulungang indigent Filipino

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: mula nung ipinatupad po ito?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: We will just submit the data, Your Honor, but there is actually a portal to monitor compliance by lawyers, but we can submit the report. We do not have the figures now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yes. Okay lang po. Mr. Chair, since tingin ko po itong next po ay need din pong isasubmit na lang, can you also provide to us the regional breakdown ng mga qualified beneficiaries?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And sa ang mga region o probinsya ang may pinakamababang access sa legal assistance sa ilalim ng ULAS?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, maraming salamat po. Malinaw na mahalaga ang ULAS sa pagpapalawak ng access to justice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Gayunman, hindi sapat na sukatin lamang ang tagumpay ng programa sa pamamagitan ng mga nakatalang oras.

segments.text: Ang higit na mahalaga ay kung paano natitiyak ng hudikatura na ang serbisyong legal ay aktual na naipa rarating at nararamdaman ng mga mahihirap na Pilipino,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: lalo na mga nasa malalayong lugar na madalas hindi naaabot ng tulong legal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Para po sa huling katanungan, Mr. Chair, ito naman po ay tungkol sa Sharia Courts.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang Sharia Courts ay mahalaga para sa aming mga Muslim Pilipinos, lalo na sa mga usapin ng family law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Pero sa mga naging konsultasyon po namin, lumalabas na mahirap pa rin po ang access ng kababaihang sa serbisyong ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ano po ang specific programs para sa 2027 ng Judiciary para siguraduhin na ang Sharia Courts ay magiging mas accessible at responsive sa pangangailangan ng mga kababaihan?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Sa Sharia District Court at Sharia Circuit Court, importante po na ma-fill upan po yung mga positions

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: kasi kadalasan po ang mga judges na qualified na mag-preside ng mga Sharia Courts ay kulang po.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So importante po talaga na ma-fill upan ang mga yun.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Ang figure po natin sa Sharia Court, we have 104.635 million

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Pesos.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po sa kanilang training.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: May naka-antabay po kaming training para sa mga Sharia, what we call the Sharia training program.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Dahil po bago nga mag-preside ang isang passer ng, sorry, sa Sharia Circuit Court kasi other than being a member of the bar,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: kailangan knowledgeable siya ng Islamic law and jurisprudence.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Unlike yung Sharia District Court, okay na yung two years minimum ng pagkakalam niya sa Islamic law and jurisprudence.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So in-expand po namin ito para mas marami nga ang makapag-apply at ma-fill upan na ang mga vacancies para sa ating particularly Sharia Circuit Courts and Sharia District Courts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yes. Maraming salamat po sa sagot na ito, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Actually, supportado ko po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Salamat po.
